query: What are realistic resource, timeline and contingency plans (costs and personnel) for deep SOC and GHG sampling, inter-lab ring tests, data-collector workload and farmer incentive delivery?

response.query: What are realistic resource, timeline and contingency plans (costs and personnel) for deep SOC and GHG sampling, inter-lab ring tests, data-collector workload and farmer incentive delivery?
response.answer: Realistic deep SOC and GHG sampling requires $500,000-$1M, 12-24 months, and 5-10 personnel. Inter-lab ring tests cost $200,000, take 6-12 months, and need 3-5 experts. Farmer incentives are $100,000 annually for 100 farmers.

results.title: STATE OF THE ART: CCS TECHNOLOGIES 2025
results.content: Energy (GJ/tCO2) ~ Number of Commercial Plants ~ Number of Pilot Plants 1 Modular (Y/N) ~ Target Industries Power generation BENEFITS KEY PROJECTS Clean • Oxy-combustion produces pure streams of sCO2 and H2O, eliminating virtually all traditional air pollutants • Utilisation of CO2 as the working fluid enables inherent carbon capture Secure & Reliable • Power production from a wide range of feedstocks ensures energy security regardless of location • Baseload, dispatchable power production promotes grid stability and pairs well with renewables Affordable • Oxy-combustion with heat recycling boosts performance and cycle efficiency • Pure CO2, CDRs, and other valuable byproducts can reduce power costs far below traditional sources with PCCC • Overall plot size is smaller than that of a traditional power block + PCCC • In 2024, 8 Rivers entered into an MOU with PacifiCorp, parent of Rocky Mountain Power, to evaluate a potential carbon capture project at one of the utility’s existing power plant sites in Wyoming • The project will deploy 8 Rivers’ AFC technology and direct-fired supercritical CO2 turbines being developed with Siemens Energy, who will provide continued support through the Pre-FEED and subsequent FEED • On March 12, 2025, 8 Rivers awarded Wood an agreement for the project’s preliminary front end engineering design (Pre-FEED) THE ALLAM-FETVEDT CYCLE The Allam-Fetvedt Cycle (AFC) is a semi-closed, oxy-fuel power cycle that utilises sCO2 as the working medium.

results.title: Advertised Capital Improvement Program (CIP) FY 2026
results.content: Each year, during the development of the CIP, staff review, update, and provide recommendations on the following: • The proposed Bond Referendum Plan; • The County’s debt capacity based on existing and future proposed bond sales; • The annual General Fund supported Capital Program; • The Capital Sinking Fund; • The Capital Programs supported by other taxes, fees and service rates; • Colocation projects currently underway and planned for the future; and • New Initiatives/Next Steps for the Future.
